spec.description: a

spec.title: Online devices
spec.description: How many selected ESP32 targets are currently scrapeable.

spec.title: Indoor–outdoor humidity Δ
spec.description: Positive value means the living room 60-second average humidity is higher than the balcony.

spec.expr:
avg_over_time(weather:relative_humidity:percent{job=~"$job", device=~"$device", room=~"$room", instance=~"$instance", placement="indoor", reference="true"}[5m]) 
- on()
avg_over_time(weather:relative_humidity:percent{job=~"$job", device=~"$device", room=~"$room", instance=~"$instance", placement="outdoor", reference="true"}[5m])

spec.title: Scrape status
spec.description: Prometheus scrape status for each selected ESP32.

spec.title: Wi-Fi connected
spec.description: Wi-Fi connection state reported by firmware.

spec.title: Wi-Fi RSSI now
spec.description: Wi-Fi signal strength. Closer to 0 is better.

spec.title: Free heap now
spec.description: Current free heap per device.

spec.title: Wi-Fi RSSI trend
spec.description: Signal trend. Useful for checking balcony signal stability.

spec.title: Free heap trend
spec.description: Useful for spotting memory leaks or fragmentation.

spec.title: Wi-Fi connection trend
spec.description: 0 means disconnected, 1 means connected.

spec.title: Scrape health trend
spec.description: 0 means Prometheus could not scrape the device.

spec.title: Device uptime
spec.description: Uptime resets indicate device reboot.

spec.title: Indoor temperature now
spec.description: Average temperature from the previous 60-second aggregation bucket.

spec.title: Temperature change rate
spec.description: Rate of change based on 60-second average temperature, in °C per hour.

spec.title: Humidity change rate
spec.description: Rate of change based on 60-second average humidity, in percentage points per hour.

spec.title: Pressure change rate
spec.description: Pressure change rate based on 60-second average pressure, in mmHg per hour.

spec.title: Temperature spread
spec.description: Difference between the warmest and coldest selected sensors using 60-second averages.

spec.expr: max(weather:temperature:celsius{job=~"$job", device=~"$device", room=~"$room", instance=~"$instance", placement=~"$placement"}) - min(weather:temperature:celsius{job=~"$job", device=~"$device", room=~"$room", instance=~"$instance", placement=~"$placement"})

spec.title: Humidity spread
spec.description: Difference between the most and least humid selected sensors using 60-second averages.

spec.expr: max(weather:relative_humidity:percent{job=~"$job", device=~"$device", room=~"$room", instance=~"$instance"}) - min(weather:relative_humidity:percent{job=~"$job", device=~"$device", room=~"$room", instance=~"$instance"})

spec.title: Indoor humidity comfort band
spec.description: Living room 60-second average humidity. Practical comfort band is usually around 40–60%.

spec.title: Temperature noise by device, 60s
spec.description: Standard deviation of temperature inside each 60-second bucket. Higher values mean less stable readings or a real short-term disturbance.

spec.title: Humidity noise by device, 60s
spec.description: Standard deviation of relative humidity inside each 60-second bucket.

spec.expr: esp32_sensor_stddev_60s{job=~"$job", device=~"$device", room=~"$room", instance=~"$instance", placement=~"$placement",sensor="bme280", field="humidity"}

spec.title: Pressure noise by device, 60s
spec.description: Standard deviation of pressure inside each 60-second bucket, converted from hPa to mmHg.

spec.title: BME280 sample count
spec.description: Number of valid BME280 samples used to calculate each 60-second average. With 5-second reads this should be around 12; with 1-second reads around 60.

spec.expr: esp32_sensor_samples_60s{job=~"$job", device=~"$device", room=~"$room", instance=~"$instance", placement=~"$placement", sensor="bme280", field="temperature"}

spec.title: Humidity now
spec.description: Average relative humidity from the previous 60-second aggregation bucket.

spec.title: BME280 read errors
spec.description: Cumulative BME280 read errors reported by the firmware.

spec.title: Light exposure today
spec.description: lux·hours

spec.title: Temperature trend
spec.description: 60-second average temperature from each ESP32 sensor.

spec.title: Outdoor temperature now
spec.description: Average temperature from the previous 60-second aggregation bucket.

spec.title: Humidity trend
spec.description: 60-second average relative humidity from each ESP32 sensor.

spec.title: Pressure now
spec.description: 60-second average pressure converted from hPa to mmHg.
Positive value means the living room 60-second average temperature is higher than the balcony.

spec.title: Weather Overview
